about_the_game:
A relaxed and lightweight roguelite tower defense game unfolding on a conveyor belt sushi restaurant!🍣🥷🤖

Game Flow:

The game consists of a repetition of the Card Purchase Phase and the Sushi Wave Phase. Players need to effectively pick up weapons, towers, and cards to gain power against the sushi waves.

Card Purchase/Effect Activation Phase
Purchase cards to increase your stats. Cards activate their effects at the start of each round.
The variety of cards available increases with Sushi Tier, allowing more cards to be activated at once.


Sushi Wave Phase
By defeating sushi and accumulating experience points, you can raise your Sushi Tier.
If you can't handle enemy attacks and your HP drops to zero, it's game over. After defeating a certain number of enemies, you enter the purchase phase.
Ultimately, if you can survive until the set time, you clear the game.

Features of "sushininjarobot TD":


  • Unpredictable Progression: With different card combinations each time, there are countless ways to win!
  • Simple Gameplay: Operate your ninja robot and quickly deal with the flowing sushi. If you keep missing them, it's game over!
  • Easy to Enjoy: Perfect for a short break!
  • Unique Hand-Drawn Graphics: Graphics made during a short break!
  • Unnecessarily Long Opening: A unique opening specific to this game!

What "sushininjarobot TD" does not offer:


  • Multiplayer
  • Elaborate puzzle-like level design

Video/Streaming Guidelines

You are free to create monetized videos and streams without permission, regardless of whether you are an individual or a corporation.
